name: brewery
description: Brewery's pipeline: distill a request into a signed-off IP, cut it from the requester's side, barrel it through Pick and Roast to a PR, and finish it to green CI. tap takes issues straight to a fixed, green PR. harvest sweeps and labels a repo's issues daily with human sign-off; polish drives your broken PRs to mergeable.

interface.shortDescription: Distill, barrel, tap, and finish work to green PRs; harvest issues and polish PRs daily
